title: GRIT: Gradient Masking for Visually Misgrounded Tokens in Text-Rich Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended to vision-language models (VLMs), yet its effectiveness remains limited for text-rich reasoning tasks. We highlight a key factor contributing to this limitation: models frequently arrive at correct final answers despite misperceiving visual information during intermediate steps. We define this phenomenon as Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR). Because standard RLVR rewards only final-answer correctness, it fails to differentiate between properly grounded and misgrounded reasoning, reinforcing both equally. Through token-level analysis, we reveal that CVMR tokens exhibit distinct attention patterns that differ systematically from well-grounded ones. Based on this observation, we propose GRIT, a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR to mitigate the impact of CVMR. Furthermore, to address the lack of text-rich reasoning

translated_title: GRIT：通过梯度掩码处理富文本推理中视觉锚定错误的词元
translated_abstract: 最近，可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已被扩展到视觉语言模型（VLM），但其在富文本推理任务中的有效性仍然有限。我们强调了导致这一局限的一个关键因素：模型经常在中间步骤中误读视觉信息，却仍然得出正确的最终答案。我们将这一现象定义为“正确但视觉误锚定的推理”。由于标准RLVR只奖励最终答案的正确性，它无法区分锚定正确与锚定错误的推理，对两者一视同仁地加以强化。通过词元级别的分析，我们揭示出CVMR词元表现出与锚定良好的词元存在系统性差异的注意力模式。基于这一观察，我们提出了GRIT，一个将视觉锚定融入RLVR的训练框架，以减轻CVMR的影响。此外，为解决富文本推理中……
tldr: 提出GRIT训练框架，通过梯度掩码将视觉锚定引入可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），以解决视觉语言模型在富文本推理中“答案正确但视觉误锚定”（CVMR）的问题。
en_tdlr: GRIT is a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR via gradient masking to mitigate Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR) in vision-language models for text-rich reasoning tasks.
